messages:
Maria R: Quick heads-up — we need to cut v1.14.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Please freeze non-critical PRs. @Ben K can you confirm no infra changes landing?
Ben K: No infra changes planned. I have one small kube tweak but will hold it for next patch.
Aj Patel: Is the changelog up-to-date? I saw one missing item from the telemetry team.
Ciara L: Adding telemetry entry now. Will push a short blurb.
Ciara L: Changelog draft:
- telemetry: reduce metrics emission for idle flows (fixes noisy billing)
- runtime: improve batch scheduler stability for long sequences
- docs: clarifications on model pinning policy
Maria R: Perfect — thx. Reminder: bump package version in repo root (package.json) before branch cut.
Aj Patel: small reminder on workflow: please rebase onto release-base and cherry-pick any late fixes to the release branch rather than merging to main. Example:
```
# create release branch
git checkout -b release/v1.14.0 release-base
# cherry-pick fix PR
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
# push
git push origin release/v1.14.0
```
Ben K: deploy-bot scheduled the branch create for 10:05 PT, leaving a 5m buffer.
deploy-bot: scheduled release branch created: release/v1.14.0 (initiated by Maria R)
Aj Patel: CI e2e is currently flaky — recording a 1.5h run to be safe. If tests fail we'll likely slip the public announce by ~4 hours. Is that acceptable?
Maria R: Ok — we can delay announcement but should still cut the branch on time so customers with early access can test. I'll mark the release as 'internal canary' if announce slips.
Ben K: Agree. I'll keep an eye on the e2e run. If green, I'll start canary deploy at +30m and ping @channel.
Ciara L: If we do slip, can someone draft a short note for #announcements? Something like:
"Planned v1.14.0 release: branch cut complete. Public rollout ETA TBD after final e2e verification (we expect an update within 4 hours)."
Maria R: I'll draft and post in #announcements once I have a firm ETA. For now tagging product for any doc updates: @Aj Patel please confirm the changelog phrasing is release-ready.
Aj Patel: LGTM after the telemetry wording tweak I pushed.
Ben K: Quick checklist I will run at cut: verify package version bumped, changelog present, no open hotfix PRs, canary pipeline trigger.
Maria R: Thanks all. If anything blocks the cut, drop a short note here. Otherwise assume branch cut at 10:05 PT and internal canary to follow. :rocket:
Ciara L: Will coordinate the cherry-picks now.
Ben K: monitoring CI — will report status in this thread.
deploy-bot: CI run queued (job/ci-e2e/1790123456)
Ben K: CI passed on the last run, now running full e2e.
Ben K: UPDATE 00:06: e2e found a flaky assertion in rerank tests — root cause being investigated. Possible rollback of one change.
Maria R: Noted. Hold the public announce. If it's just rerank flaky test, can we disable test and continue? We should avoid shipping a functional rollback without an engineering review.
Aj Patel: I'll take the rerank fix and prepare a small hotfix PR to cherry-pick; won't change runtime semantics. ETA ~1h.
Maria R: Thanks. Keep updates short here. If ETA slips beyond 4h we escalate to the oncall.
Ben K: Copy — will update in 30m.
